an allele that is only expressed in the phenotype when two copies are present (homozygous recessive)
having two identical alleles for a particular trait (e.g., BB or bb)
a pattern of inheritance where one allele completely masks the expression of the other in a heterozygote
explanation: By contrasting the two, Heterozygous is defined as having two different alleles for a particular trait (e.g., Bb).
